facts.fact: Neela stops the queen burning the four remaining crown-leaf pages, because each carries its intake roll looped on by green thread. She cuts the rolls free with Usha's belt knife and hands them to the four guards.
Sajan chooses to burn his own crown-leaf page himself and keeps his intake roll (it names a younger brother sold at seven). The other three guards keep their pages unburned and undecided.
Devan has a three-day-old rope blister on his good left palm, raised hauling the shed door. Neela's grip presses it and a welt rises on her own palm.
Muthu has carried the iron warden's disc since Devan gave it up in the hall at Kettamala.
The charter clause reads that the crown kept in office the councillor who bought Asha's death and sealed the writ for the warden's death.
Pachan alone carries water at the groves kennels.
